retained_requirement_correction.original_assumption: Immersive presentation makes existing and newly created inline sessions hidden; document hide/show cannot reveal them; immersive exit restores visible and fires a visibility event.
retained_requirement_correction.corrected_requirement: Inline visibility mirrors the owning document before/during/after immersive presentation. Suspend rendering independently, retaining cancellable ordered callbacks; immersive entry/exit alone emits no visibility event. Actual state changes deliver owning XRSessionEvent notifications through listeners and properties.
retained_requirement_correction.rationale: Scheduling suppression must not manufacture visibility transitions.

final_observed_behavior.immersive_entry_exit: No inline visibility events; existing and newly created sessions visible whenever the document is visible.
final_observed_behavior.native_hide_restore: Before/during sessions report hidden,visible,hidden,visible in each immersive round; hidden-created session reports initial hidden then one visible event. Inline-only before/during sessions report hidden,visible. Listener and property sequences match, and each event is XRSessionEvent with its owning session.
final_observed_behavior.scheduling: Surviving callbacks remain queued during immersive presentation and native hidden state; cancellation removes the cancelled callback. Explicit exit while visible resumes native callbacks 1,2. Device exit while hidden retains queues until native restoration, then resumes 1,2. Queues drain exactly once per session.
final_observed_behavior.pixels: Readback assertions require before-session red [255,0,0,255], during-session green [0,255,0,255], hidden-created magenta [255,0,255,255], and immersive blue [0,0,255,255] on each session-owned base layer. Inline observations below retain measured pixels; before-session pixels also include its initial warmup frame.
final_observed_behavior.shutdown: Ended inline sessions deliver no queued callback, stale-tick callback or document-driven event; listener identity removed. All live-session document listeners released at completion.
final_observed_behavior.preserved: Viewer-only inline negotiation, selected Quest VR/MR and Android AR, immersive blend mode/rendering and concurrency InvalidStateError; both existing #41 shutdown suites pass.
